dialogues.jp:
「さてと、さくっと購買にでも行って、エサを
　買って来るか」
dialogues.en: "Time to hurry off to the stores to get the rations."
dialogues.text: "Time to hurry off to the stores to get the rations."

dialogues.jp: 厳しい争奪戦に参加すべく、廊下に出る。
dialogues.en:
Getting ready to participate in a fierce battle, I emerged
into the corridor.
dialogues.text:
Getting ready to participate in a fierce battle, I emerged
into the corridor.

dialogues.jp:
（おやっ、あそこで楽しそうに語り合っている
　のは……）
dialogues.en:
"(Oho, that looks like an interesting combination to talk
to.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Oho, that looks like an interesting combination to talk
to.)"

dialogues.jp: ななこと工藤という珍しい組み合わせだった。
dialogues.en: Nanako and Kudou were talking, a rare pairing.
dialogues.text: Nanako and Kudou were talking, a rare pairing.

dialogues.jp: ななこが俺に気づいて手を振る。
dialogues.en: Nanako noticed me lurking, and waved.
dialogues.text: Nanako noticed me lurking, and waved.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、珍しい組み合わせだな」
dialogues.en: "I don't see you two together often."
dialogues.text: "I don't see you two together often."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「すまん、お邪魔虫だったみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, guess I'm getting in the way."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, guess I'm getting in the way."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「お邪魔虫って？」
dialogues.en: "Getting in the way?"
dialogues.text: "Getting in the way?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、工藤がななこを口説いているのかと思っ
　て」
dialogues.en: "Ah-ah, I thought you two were having a lover's quarrel."
dialogues.text: "Ah-ah, I thought you two were having a lover's quarrel."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「バカ。お前は、なんてこと言うんだ」
dialogues.en: "Idiot, what are you saying?"
dialogues.text: "Idiot, what are you saying?"

dialogues.jp: 工藤が珍しく慌てた顔で否定する。
dialogues.en: Kudou was flustered in denying my jab.
dialogues.text: Kudou was flustered in denying my jab.

dialogues.jp: 「違った？」
dialogues.en: "Am I wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Am I wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「違うも何も、お話ししていただけですよ」
dialogues.en: "Wrong or not, we were just talking."
dialogues.text: "Wrong or not, we were just talking."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「それだけだ。誤解を招くようなこと言うな」
dialogues.en: "That's all. Don't just jump to conclusions like that!"
dialogues.text: "That's all. Don't just jump to conclusions like that!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、やけに親しそうだったからさ」
dialogues.en: "Well, you two looked so close!"
dialogues.text: "Well, you two looked so close!"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「工藤くんのおうちと、うちがご近所さんって
　ことなわけですよ」
dialogues.en: "Kudou-kun's home is in the same neighbourhood as mine."
dialogues.text: "Kudou-kun's home is in the same neighbourhood as mine."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「幼なじみってヤツか」
dialogues.en: "So you were childhood friends, eh?"
dialogues.text: "So you were childhood friends, eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そんなところだ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, you could say that."
dialogues.text: "Yes, you could say that."

dialogues.jp: 工藤は、じろりと俺を見た。
dialogues.en: Kudou continued to stare me down, daring me to act up again.
dialogues.text: Kudou continued to stare me down, daring me to act up again.

dialogues.jp: 「で、何の話をしていたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What were you taling about?"
dialogues.text: "What were you taling about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「動物の話ですよ。犬とかネコとか」
dialogues.en: "About animals... cats and dogs, specifically."
dialogues.text: "About animals... cats and dogs, specifically."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「どんな動物をペットにしたいとか、そんなこ
　とを話していたんだ」
dialogues.en: "About which of those we'd rather have as a pet."
dialogues.text: "About which of those we'd rather have as a pet."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、少なくともヤギは飼いたくないな」
dialogues.en: "...I guess a goat would be out of the question."
dialogues.text: "...I guess a goat would be out of the question."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "A goat...?"
dialogues.text: "A goat...?"

dialogues.jp: 工藤が｛けげん／怪訝｝そうな顔をした。
dialogues.en: Kudou was understandbly dubious at my words.
dialogues.text: Kudou was understandbly dubious at my words.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ああ！　ヤギだけは、絶対絶対ダメです！
　ヤーギーだーけーはー！　ダメですッ！」
dialogues.en:
"Ahhh! Definitely not! There's NO WAY I'd ever raise a
goat!'
dialogues.text:
"Ahhh! Definitely not! There's NO WAY I'd ever raise a
goat!'

dialogues.jp: ななこが、髪を振り乱し、頭を抱える。
dialogues.en:
Nanako shook her head so hard, her hair became entirely
disheveled.
dialogues.text:
Nanako shook her head so hard, her hair became entirely
disheveled.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「さ、彩珠さん……。ヤギにトラウマでも」
dialogues.en: "S, Saitama-san... does she have some goat trauma?"
dialogues.text: "S, Saitama-san... does she have some goat trauma?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ははは、ちょっとな」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha, kinda."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha, kinda."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、メガネにヒビが入りかねない勢いのなな
こを静める。
dialogues.en: I had to eventually calm the shivering Nanako down.
dialogues.text: I had to eventually calm the shivering Nanako down.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、どっちにしても、ヤギはペットとは
　ちょっと違うな」
dialogues.en: "In any case, goats aren't quite what I'd call a pet."
dialogues.text: "In any case, goats aren't quite what I'd call a pet."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、カピバラなんてどうだ？」
dialogues.en: "How about a Kapibara, then?"
dialogues.text: "How about a Kapibara, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……カピバラ？」
dialogues.en: "...Kapibara?"
dialogues.text: "...Kapibara?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「あたしは知ってますけど、なんて説明してい
　いのか……」
dialogues.en: "I've heard of it, but not enough to explain it..."
dialogues.text: "I've heard of it, but not enough to explain it..."

dialogues.jp: 俺が簡潔に説明してやることにした。
dialogues.en: I gave a short and sweet description.
dialogues.text: I gave a short and sweet description.

dialogues.jp:
「カピバラは、何を隠そう世界最大のげっ歯類
　だぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Kapibara is a often concealed type of animal, with the
biggest teeth around."
dialogues.text:
"Kapibara is a often concealed type of animal, with the
biggest teeth around."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「げっ歯類って、それ……ネズミか？」
dialogues.en: "Biggest teeth... you mean mice?"
dialogues.text: "Biggest teeth... you mean mice?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だから、世界最大のネズミってことだ」
dialogues.en: "Like I said, the world's biggest mice."
dialogues.text: "Like I said, the world's biggest mice."

dialogues.jp:
どんな動物を想像したのかは分からないが工藤
が眉をひそめる。
dialogues.en: Kudou couldn't quite seem to picture it in his mind.
dialogues.text: Kudou couldn't quite seem to picture it in his mind.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、その顔は。ネズミをバカにしてはい
　かん」
dialogues.en: "What's with that face? Mice are animals too."
dialogues.text: "What's with that face? Mice are animals too."

dialogues.jp:
「見てみろ、ウォルトさんの所の、三木……う
　おっぷ」
dialogues.en:
"I mean, just look at how famous Walt-san has made...
mprhrphrh."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, just look at how famous Walt-san has made...
mprhrphrh."

dialogues.jp: 工藤がいきなり俺の口をふさいだ。
dialogues.en: Kudou suddenly shot his hand over my mouth.
dialogues.text: Kudou suddenly shot his hand over my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「落ち着け、朝倉。それ以上は言っちゃあダメ
　だ……」
dialogues.en: "Hold up, Asakura. You can't speak further on that..."
dialogues.text: "Hold up, Asakura. You can't speak further on that..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「工藤さんの言うとおり。危険ですよ、そのネ
　ズミさんの話は」
dialogues.en:
"Kudou-san's right. It's dangerous talking about that
mouse."
dialogues.text:
"Kudou-san's right. It's dangerous talking about that
mouse."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「わ、わかったから、放せ。窒息させる気か」
dialogues.en: "O, okay, let go already, I'm suffocating!"
dialogues.text: "O, okay, let go already, I'm suffocating!"

dialogues.jp:
野郎のわりには繊細で柔らかな工藤の手が俺か
ら離れる。
dialogues.en: That bastard's soft hand finally moved from my mouth.
dialogues.text: That bastard's soft hand finally moved from my mouth.

dialogues.jp:
「だから、俺が言いたいことはだな。カピバラ
　くんも描く人が描けば、それなりに世界的な
　ヒットを飛ばすかもしれんということだ」
dialogues.en:
"As I was saying, thanks to the way Kapibara-kun is made out
to be, he was an instant hit worldwide."
dialogues.text:
"As I was saying, thanks to the way Kapibara-kun is made out
to be, he was an instant hit worldwide."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「……ペットの話からずれてますよ」
dialogues.en: "...I thought we were talking about pets."
dialogues.text: "...I thought we were talking about pets."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、それはいい。でもおまえ、カピバラの
　どこが好きなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Well whatever... what do you like about Kapibara?"
dialogues.text: "Well whatever... what do you like about Kapibara?"

dialogues.jp: え、えーと。
dialogues.en: Hm... erm...
dialogues.text: Hm... erm...

dialogues.jp: 「…………食用になるところ？」
dialogues.en: "......They taste good fried and battered?"
dialogues.text: "......They taste good fried and battered?"

dialogues.jp: ななこと、工藤が怪訝そうな顔で俺の方を見る。
dialogues.en: Both of them gave me withering looks.
dialogues.text: Both of them gave me withering looks.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、変わってるな、朝倉は」
dialogues.en: "...I always knew you were weird, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "...I always knew you were weird, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「……知らなかった。カピバラって食用になる
　んだ」
dialogues.en: "...I didn't know Kapibara were edible..."
dialogues.text: "...I didn't know Kapibara were edible..."

dialogues.jp:
ななこがメガネを曇らせながら、口をあんぐり
と開けていた。
dialogues.en: She said slack-jawed, her glasses steaming up.
dialogues.text: She said slack-jawed, her glasses steaming up.

dialogues.jp: 工藤が苦笑しながら、やれやれと首を振る。
dialogues.en: Kudou just sighed and shrugged his shoulders.
dialogues.text: Kudou just sighed and shrugged his shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
ちなみに、カピバラの魅力といえば、本当は、
ずんぐりむっくりなところとか、尻尾がないと
ことろとか、水かきがあるところとか……。
dialogues.en:
In any case, as charming as they are, they tend to live in
damp and gloomy places...
dialogues.text:
In any case, as charming as they are, they tend to live in
damp and gloomy places...

dialogues.jp: ……あまり可愛くないな。
dialogues.en: ...That part tends to turn people off.
dialogues.text: ...That part tends to turn people off.

dialogues.jp: 食用肉として、養殖されてるってのは本当だぞ。
dialogues.en:
Although it's also true that they're sometimes raised to be
eaten.
dialogues.text:
Although it's also true that they're sometimes raised to be
eaten.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ま、まあ、こんな所で立ち話もなんですから、
　みんなで学食にでも行きませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"W, well, instead of standing around here, why don't we head
to the cafeteria?"
dialogues.text:
"W, well, instead of standing around here, why don't we head
to the cafeteria?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「オレ的には賛成」
dialogues.en: "I agree."
dialogues.text: "I agree."

dialogues.jp: ななこと工藤が同時に俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Both of them looked straight at me.
dialogues.text: Both of them looked straight at me.

dialogues.jp: まあ、俺もメシはまだだった訳だし。
dialogues.en: Well, I haven't eaten yet either.
dialogues.text: Well, I haven't eaten yet either.

dialogues.jp: 「では、満場一致で可決ということで」
dialogues.en: "The verdict is a unanimous approval."
dialogues.text: "The verdict is a unanimous approval."

dialogues.jp: 学食に向かって３人で歩き出す。
dialogues.en: The three of us walked to the cafeteria together.
dialogues.text: The three of us walked to the cafeteria together.

dialogues.jp: 俺の横に来たななこが、そっと呟く。
dialogues.en: On the way, Nanako sighed beside me.
dialogues.text: On the way, Nanako sighed beside me.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「でも、カピバラってかわいいですよね」
dialogues.en: "They really are cute though..."
dialogues.text: "They really are cute though..."

dialogues.jp: よしよし。いい趣味だ、ななこ。
dialogues.en: Yes yes, good senses, Nanako.
dialogues.text: Yes yes, good senses, Nanako.

dialogues.jp: ◆ペット談義◆
dialogues.en: ◆Pet Lectures◆
dialogues.text: ◆Pet Lectures◆

dialogues.jp:
食堂に向かおうとした俺は廊下でななこと工藤
を見かけた。なんだか珍しい取り合わせだ。
dialogues.en:
Heading to the cafeteria, I bumped into the odd pairing of
Kudou and Nanako.
dialogues.text:
Heading to the cafeteria, I bumped into the odd pairing of
Kudou and Nanako.

dialogues.jp: 三人でペット談義になる。
dialogues.en: We had a talk about pets.
dialogues.text: We had a talk about pets.

dialogues.jp:
カピバラの可愛さがわかるとは、ななこはなか
なか見所がある奴だ。
dialogues.en: Nanako's an interesting one, saying that Kapibara are cute.
dialogues.text: Nanako's an interesting one, saying that Kapibara are cute.
